description: This PHP source file defines the class `SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectAccountButton`, which extends `SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectButton`. The class contains a `display` method that checks user permissions before rendering a select button for Accounts within the SuiteCRM framework. The file includes licensing, copyright, and security check code.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectAccountButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a select button for Account subpanels with permission checks.
